title: Customer Service Administrator
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic, organised and motivated individual to join our client's team as an Order Management Coordinator. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to develop their career in administration, customer service or sales support, with the chance to gain experience across the full customer order process. From processing orders and coordinating deliveries to liaising with customers and supporting internal teams, you will play an important role in ensuring everything runs smoothly and customers receive an excellent level of service. If you're a confident communicator, enjoy staying organised and are comfortable juggling different tasks in a busy environment, this could be a great opportunity to take the next step in your career. Key Responsibilities - Support the end-to-end order management process, including quotations, order processing, delivery coordination, invoicing and returns. - Process customer orders accurately, ensuring pricing, customer details and delivery requirements are correct. - Monitor order progress, proactively identifying and resolving issues or delays to minimise customer impact. - Coordinate deliveries and stock movements, working closely with Shipping and Warehouse teams to meet SLAs. - Act as a key point of contact for clients, providing updates on stock availability, order status and expected deliveries. - Handle customer enquiries via telephone and email, ensuring a professional and timely resolution. - Maintain accurate customer records, order information, sales contracts and associated documentation. Skills and Experience - Some previous experience in administration, customer service or sales support would be beneficial. - Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple orders and priorities simultaneously. - Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when processing information. - Confident communication skills, with the ability to liaise professionally with customers and internal stakeholders. - A proactive approach to problem-solving, with the ability to identify and resolve issues effectively. - Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office. - A customer-focused approach with a commitment to delivering a high standard of service. Details: Title: Order Management Coordinator Location: Camberley, fully office-based Contract: Permanent, full-time Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 4pm This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills within a busy and supportive team, gain valuable experience in order management and build a long-term career within a successful business.
